notes.title: New Game Announcement! "Uninvited Guest" page is already available on Steam!
notes.content:
[b]Uninvited Guest[/b] is a first-person psychological horror game set in 1930. You play as a villager who was destined to end up in an old mansion.

[i]One day, during a rainy gray season, my beloved daughter fell seriously ill. She won’t last long without expensive and rare medicine. But, alas, we are a poor family having barely enough funds to buy food.
Fortunately, I met a collector from a big city. He was just traveling through our village and looking for someone who could pull off a delicate request: a painting, one of its kind, was hidden somewhere inside the old mansion. In exchange for the painting, the collector was offering a generous reward. I had no other options. Not wasting any minute, I mount the horse and head to the old mansion. I hope my daughter won't get worse.[/i]


[i][b]Game features:[/b][/i]

[list]
[*] First-person game
[*] Explore the old mansion that holds dark and dour secrets
[*] Horrifying ambient and sounds
[*] You can never guess what is waiting for you around the corner
[*] Realistic graphics that emphasizes the atmosphere of horror
[*] Achieved with CryEngine V
[/list]

notes.title: ColdSide - update 1.1
notes.content:
[b]ColdSide - update 1.1[/b]

[list]
[*] Added support for xbox gamepad
[*] Added Turkish language (thanks "Checkpoint Localization")


[b]Some gameplay aspects have been changed:[/b]
[*] At the first level, you no longer need to look for a password and enter it into a computer, it is enough to find a card.
[*] At the fifth level, the scene of the interrogation of the main character was removed; a small cutscene was added.
[*] At the sixth level, you don't need to look for a computer to open the door to the rebel base.
[*] Minor bug fixes.
[/list]

[b]Warning! Due to the peculiarities of the engine, after the update, the old save may not work by clicking the "Continue game" button. Select a level from the game menu.[/b]

notes.title: ColdSide - update 1.02 test branch
notes.content:
Update 1.02 test branch:

[list]
[*] Added support for xbox gamepad
[*] Some gameplay aspects have been changed:
At the first level, you no longer need to look for a password and enter it into a computer, it is enough to find a card.
At the fifth level, the scene of the interrogation of the main character was removed; a small cutscene was added.
At the sixth level, you don't need to look for a computer to open the door to the rebel base.
[*] Minor bug fixes.
[/list]

You can take part in the beta test of the update by right-clicking on the game name and choosing the Properties line.
In the properties window, select the tab called BETA VERSIONS. On this page, select xbox_gamepad_test from the drop down menu. If you are already taking part in testing, you can opt out by selecting the appropriate menu item.
Once you have made your selection, close the properties window by clicking the Close button. After closing the window, the update will start.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36595167/86d94e5d9d5b341c414c6f64bda7c44bd264fcef.png[/img]


Don't forget to leave your feedback on the update in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1098270/discussions/]Steam Discussions[/url]! Thanks.

notes.title: ColdSide - Update 1.01
notes.content:
This update includes various improvements and bug fixes.

[b]Update 1.01[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed - On the first level, the bucket could fall and prevent the player from going further.

[*] Added - Hints for non-obvious points. Some hints may not appear immediately, but after several failures to the players.
[*] Added - Now the game can be played without killing a soldier on the second level (added choice)
[*] Added - New achievement "I am not a killer"
[/list]

[b]Warning! Due to the peculiarities of the engine, after the update, the old save may not work by clicking the "Continue game" button. Select a level from the game menu.[/b]
